module: OBSOLETE auxiliary controller (replaced by the 'genericGauges' controller) that feeds the digital dashboard screen of the Vivace: it creates an HTML texture (1024x256) and periodically sends it electrics values (turn signals, indicators, RPM, speed, ESC/TCS, average power of the electric motors). Loaded via the jbeam; do not use for new vehicles.
usage: -- jbeam: controller "vivaceGauges" with materialName and htmlPath; setParameters({modeName="ECO", modeColor="#00ff00"}) changes the displayed mode
notes: jbeam fields read: materialName (screen material name, required), htmlPath (HTML page, required); the whole jbeamData is merged with {unit = uiUnitLength setting or 'metric'} then sent to the page by the JS call 'setup'.
init always writes a log error saying the controller is obsolete. Without materialName or htmlPath, M.updateGFX is replaced by nop.

Data sent (JS call 'updateData'): temp (ambient temperature in °C), electrics.{signal_L, signal_R, lights, highbeam, fog (always 0), lowpressure, lowfuel, parkingbrake, checkengine, hazard, oil, cruiseControlActive, gear, rpmTacho, fuel, watertemp, engineRunning, wheelspeed, esc, escActive, tcs, tcsActive, pwr}. pwr = average of (throttle - regenThrottle) of the electricMotor devices, forced to 0 if wheelspeed <= 0.5 m/s.
Updates only if a player is seated and if obj:getUpdateUIflag() is true; the texture refresh rate is 15 FPS.
Anomaly: updateTimer is incremented and reset to 0 but is never tested to limit the rate.

type.desc: 'auxiliary': controller type in the controller system.

init.desc: Called at controller initialization: creates the HTML texture, gets the powertrain's electric motors and sends the configuration to the page ('setup').

reset.desc: Called at vehicle reset; does nothing.

updateGFX.desc: Called every frame: sends the dashboard values to the HTML texture when the UI needs updating. Is nop if the configuration is invalid.

setParameters.desc: Changes the displayed mode (JS call 'updateMode' with {txt, col}) if modeName and modeColor are present.

parameters.desc: Table with modeName (text) and modeColor (color, format used by the HTML page).
